criterion: CS-ATTN is LIVE if ALL of: (a) the 3-seed ensemble improves tail-IC(top-half) ≥ +0.010 AND top-decile overlap ≥ +0.015 vs the frozen GBM baseline on the full OOS; (b) seed dispersion is small: max−min of per-seed full-OOS tail-IC(top-half) ≤ 0.010; (c) the §B null passes. CS-ATTN is PARKED otherwise, and the verdict sentence must state which clause failed. If PARKED on clause (a) with dispersion passing, the conclusion 'the price/volume ceiling is real at this scale' is recorded in the project ledger. Nothing is adopted; any production use requires a fresh pre-registered phase. Mechanical, no post-hoc adjustment.
null_gate: Adapted E.1b on folds {5, 21} × 10 within-date label-shuffle replicates (train seed 42 only). (a) BIAS: for each fold, the null mean of per-date tail-IC(top-half) must satisfy |mean| ≤ 2·(null SD / √R). CONTAMINATED if ≥2 fold-level violations (original E.1b tolerance). (b) SKILL: seed-42 real fold tail-IC(top-half) must exceed that fold's null 95th percentile on both folds. §B null PASSES iff not CONTAMINATED AND skill passes.
death_convention: A held coin whose data ends is force-exited at its last available close (no better information assumed). The count and PnL impact of such forced exits is reported in every backtest of this project.
